name: fgc-install-esm-consumer
//: The install-level consumer for #90. It is a real project in the shape pnpm installs:
every dependency below is a `file:` link into `./packages/`, and the packages that have
their own dependencies declare them the same way, so the install graph (including its
virtual store and per-package links) is produced by the package manager rather than by a
The test copies this directory to a temporary root and runs `pnpm install --offline`
there, so this committed tree is never written to. Nothing here is a registry dependency:
`--offline` therefore touches no network, and a fresh runner installs in about a second.
`fgc-fixture-transitive-dep` is listed here as well as in `fgc-fixture-transitive`'s own
manifest. Under pnpm's isolated layout a package reached only through its parent is not
addressable from the project root, so `probe --project <root> fgc-fixture-transitive-dep`
could not locate it — while the compiler still requires a decision for every bare specifier
the bundle inlines. Declaring it here is what a real project does when its Cells reach a
transitive package. The *import* stays transitive: `consumer/App.tsx` imports only
